outcome: proportion of women diagnosed with prolonged and or obstructed labour
cohort: The study reviewed labour monitoring records of 2011 women admitted to eight publicly funded midwife-led community health facilities in rural Mbarara district, Southwestern Uganda, for labour in 2023 and 2024.
finding: The modified WHO labour care guide (LCG) diagnosed significantly more cases of prolonged and obstructed labour compared to the traditional partograph among women delivering in rural Ugandan facilities.
mod_finding: The LCG group had significantly increased Caesarean section rates compared to the partograph group.
